notes: The flow never calls crew:run(); provider credentials and base URL are fail-closed fixtures.
Host-process RSS and pod/container cgroup memory are separate scopes.
The 1 GiB default is a report comparator, not a locally enforced Railway/OpenShift limit.
WAL and pg_stat_database deltas are database-wide; use an isolated database for attribution.

attribution.table_and_index_metrics: measured for the isolated IronCrew prefix
attribution.wal_and_database_activity: measured database-wide; concurrent workloads can contribute to these deltas

pg_stat_statements.attribution: measured statement counters filtered by table prefix; unavailable without pg_stat_statements and sufficient permissions

cgroup_scope.warning: cgroup values include every process in that cgroup; they are not per-process RSS

a.peak_semantics: sampled RSS only; macOS exposes no live per-child native peak here

b.peak_semantics: sampled RSS only; macOS exposes no live per-child native peak here

semantics.derived_server_opportunities: latency divided by configured poll interval; not a database call count
semantics.measured_client: exact requests/connections issued by this runner
semantics.postgres_measured_calls: reported separately only when pg_stat_statements is installed and readable
